issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation adds 'tối cao' (supreme/highest) to the name 'Phê-lít', which does not appear in the Greek text ('φηλιξ').

The Greek 'κρατιστε' is an imperative or a vocative form of 'krateros' (strong/mighty), but in this specific context, it is often interpreted as a title or address. However, the Vietnamese adds 'tối cao' which implies a superlative not present in the single adjective.
